projects.title: Kroma Cloud Monitoring Platform
projects.role: Lead Product Designer & Principal Full-Stack Engineer
projects.shortDescription: Next-generation telemetry and infrastructure orchestration platform with millisecond latency monitoring.
projects.description: An enterprise-scale distributed cloud monitor delivering real-time telemetry, visual node topology maps, and predictive capacity analytics for modern DevOps teams.
projects.challenge: DevOps engineers faced fragmented tools requiring context-switching between log aggregators, AWS metrics, and APM tracing. The client needed a unified dashboard processing 120,000 events/second without browser lag.
projects.approach: Designed an ultra-dense, low-cognitive-load UI inspired by avionics instrumentation. Architected a multi-threaded web worker pipeline for real-time D3 rendering and high-frequency WebSocket streaming.
projects.designDirection: Monochrome slate canvas with purposeful semantic status indicators.
projects.developmentDetails: Built a C# .NET Core telemetry gateway connecting to TimescaleDB and Redis Streams with Next.js App Router.
keyFeatures: Interactive visual cluster topology explorer with live node health
Instant query engine with syntax highlighting and autocompletion
Custom alert escalation matrix with Slack and WhatsApp webhooks

projects.title: Vanguard Capital Wealth Portal
projects.shortDescription: High-frequency wealth portal with real-time portfolio rebalancing and algorithmic trade execution.
projects.description: An institutional investment platform managing multi-asset portfolios, private equity liquidity allocations, and regulatory tax compliance for family offices.
projects.challenge: Migrating legacy financial management spreadsheets into a browser-native portal while maintaining rigorous compliance and encryption.
projects.approach: Engineered a dual-ledger accounting database in PostgreSQL paired with a clean, trustworthy editorial interface.
projects.designDirection: High-end Swiss typography, muted sage and charcoal accents.
projects.developmentDetails: Hybrid backend with PHP 8.3 APIs and Next.js frontend with optimistic UI updates.
keyFeatures: Multi-currency automated rebalancing simulation with slider controls
One-click PDF investor memorandum and tax statement generation
Bank-grade biometric WebAuthn multi-factor authentication

projects.title: Strata Design System & Web Components
projects.role: Creator, Design Systems Architect & Frontend Engineer
projects.shortDescription: Multi-brand headless token framework and React/Tailwind component ecosystem for engineering teams.
projects.description: A comprehensive multi-platform design architecture bridging Figma tokens with React, Vue, and Next.js implementations, boasting 90+ accessible components.
projects.challenge: Engineering teams suffered from inconsistent UX, redundant styling debt, and painful dark-mode regressions across releases.
projects.approach: Established a strict mathematical spacing scale, centralized token schema, and automated sync pipelines.
projects.designDirection: Subtle borders, micro-radii, restrained color accents.
projects.developmentDetails: Crafted with headless Radix primitives, Tailwind CSS v4 custom variants, and comprehensive TypeScript strict typing.
keyFeatures: Automated Figma-to-Code token synchronization
Accessible focus-rings and full keyboard navigation primitives
Dual-theme color engine calibrated for WCAG contrast

projects.title: Lumen Architectural Storefront
projects.shortDescription: Editorial e-commerce experience for an artisan architectural lighting atelier.
projects.description: A bespoke headless commerce experience blending Scandinavian editorial photography with an interactive 3D luminaire customizer and instant checkout.
projects.challenge: Showcasing intricate glass and brass finishes realistically without heavy page load penalties on mobile shoppers.
projects.approach: Crafted an editorial storytelling flow with progressive WebGL model streaming, ambient occlusion, and micro-interactions.
projects.designDirection: Warm alabaster surfaces, refined serif typography paired with technical monospace specifications.
projects.developmentDetails: Next.js dynamic caching, edge middleware geo-pricing, and seamless headless checkout.
keyFeatures: Real-time material and finish switch with dynamic lighting reflection
Instant sub-second bag drawer with localized currency conversion
Architectural spec sheet PDF auto-generator for interior designers

projects.title: Synthetix Web Digital Audio Workstation
projects.shortDescription: Browser-based generative synthesizer and multi-track sequencer with spatial audio effects.
projects.description: An in-browser digital audio workstation powered by the Web Audio API and WebAssembly, enabling modular patch synthesis and collaborative cloud sessions.
projects.challenge: Achieving zero audio glitching and jitter-free canvas waveform visualization during complex playback.
projects.approach: Offloaded audio DSP algorithms into compiled Rust/Wasm modules executed on dedicated Web Audio Worklet threads.
projects.designDirection: Hardware rackmount aesthetic reimagined through modern flat minimalism.
projects.developmentDetails: Custom virtualized timeline component handling 32 simultaneous stereo tracks with lossless WAV export.
keyFeatures: Modular cable patching matrix with drag-and-drop node connections
Polyphonic wavetable synthesis with custom harmonic shape drawing
Hardware MIDI keyboard auto-mapping via Web MIDI API

projects.title: Enterprise Cloud POS & Inventory System
projects.shortDescription: High-throughput cloud point-of-sale with offline barcode scanning and multi-branch inventory synchronization.
projects.description: A mission-critical web application designed for multi-branch retail operations with offline SQLite sync, instant receipt printing, and live sales telemetry.
projects.challenge: Ensuring zero cashier downtime during internet outages while reconciling branch inventories automatically upon reconnection.
projects.approach: Implemented local-first IndexedDB persistence with two-way conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs).
projects.designDirection: High-contrast touch-optimized interface with prominent numerical keypad and tactile feedback.
projects.developmentDetails: Built using Next.js 15 App Router and service worker background sync API.
keyFeatures: Instant thermal receipt generation and ESC/POS printer pairing
Multi-warehouse stock allocation and low-stock WhatsApp alerts
Role-based cashier permissions with shift reconciliation
